task: Connect the public preview to live v1 audit submissions and evidence-backed partial reports.
nonGoals: Paid usage, new cloud resources, changes to scoring weights or contract, unrelated Workers or Pages settings, or automatic deployment in CI.

outcomes.description: Only the existing Pages origin receives browser access on v1 audit routes, including preflight and errors.
outcomes.evidence: Worker tests cover allowed and disallowed origins, routes and responses.

outcomes.description: The live form submits and polls the v1 service, showing evidence and partial coverage without a final score for incomplete results. The sample stays independent.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen contract examples and adapter/presentation tests.

outcomes.description: The deployed preview opens a live partial assessment and shows its evidence and measured coverage.
outcomes.evidence: Browser smoke with a public demo product after independent review and hosted CI.

process.description: Use Terra implementation and independent review, retain source-bound offline evidence and deploy manually only to the two authorized resources.
process.evidence: Git history, evaluation trace, hosted CI and live verification.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the contract, design and service lifecycle. Avoid extra dependencies, broad permissions and polling past terminal states.

exitTest.reason: Audit UI and browser transport changes do not affect agent portability, memory, handoff or resumability.
